name: Radical Right
summary: The radical right is a family of nationalist, populist parties and movements that accept elections but reject liberal-democratic limits on the will of the native majority. Its core, in Cas Mudde's account, is nativism combined with authoritarian law-and-order and an anti-elite populism, usually with opposition to mass immigration, multiculturalism, Islam and EU integration. Economic positions vary widely, from market liberalism to welfare chauvinism.
scope: The contemporary Western and Central European populist radical right as defined by Mudde and Minkenberg, with the AfD's 2017 programme as the worked primary example. Excludes the extreme right (neo-fascism, neo-Nazism, Third Position groups), which rejects democracy more openly and tolerates violence, and the US radical right. Economic and institutional answers are often low-confidence because parties diverge.

markets-allocate-better.rationale: The AfD programme says state-directed economies end in misallocation and corruption (10.2), though Wikipedia notes the family has no single economic line.

public-ownership.rationale: The AfD wants a social market economy built on private ownership and bars privatisation only without citizen approval (10.2, 10.8); other strands accept more state control.

tax-the-wealthy.rationale: The AfD programme calls for abolishing wealth and inheritance taxes and a constitutional ceiling on taxation (11.2, 11.4).

cut-welfare.rationale: Welfare chauvinism favours cutting benefits for outsiders, not welfare as such, and the AfD wants work incentives rather than cuts (5.4.2); strands split.

surveillance-ok.rationale: The AfD programme backs stronger policing and refuses data protection for perpetrators (3.6), though it defends cash and encryption against state tracing.

legalize-drugs.rationale: The AfD programme links drugs with crime and wants dangerous addicts held in protective custody (3.4).

restrict-hate-speech.rationale: The AfD programme defends criticism of Islam as protected opinion and rejects the label Islamophobia (7.6.2).

strong-leader.rationale: Mudde lists authoritarianism as a core element, but the AfD wants referenda and separation of powers rather than a leader above gridlock; strands vary.

state-harmful.rationale: Radical right parties want a strong state for security, borders and justice; the AfD names security and justice as core government functions (1.2).

limit-guns.rationale: The AfD programme opposes any further tightening of firearms law (3.5), though continental radical right parties are less uniform on this.

empower-police-military.rationale: The AfD programme demands more police staff, minimum sentences for attacks on officers, a restored armed forces and conscription (3.1, 3.3, 4.4).

decide-locally.rationale: The AfD calls for subsidiarity and federalism (2.2, 11.8), though it wants national rather than EU control.

rehabilitation.rationale: The AfD says protect victims not offenders and wants preventive custody and tighter parole (3.4).

traditional-family.rationale: The AfD programme names the traditional family a guiding principle and nucleus of society (6.1).

same-sex-marriage.rationale: The AfD programme honours the traditional family (6.1) but the sources are silent on same-sex marriage, and Dutch and Nordic parties accept it; strands split.

abortion-legal.rationale: The AfD says life starts with the embryo, wants counselling to protect unborn life and opposes state support for abortion (6.7); some western parties are less restrictive.

more-religion-public.rationale: The AfD names Christianity a root of the dominant culture (7.2) but is mainly cultural about it, and several strands are secular.

gender-social-construct.rationale: The AfD programme demands an end to gender ideology and funding of gender studies (8.1.2, 8.3).

preserve-national-culture.rationale: The AfD programme makes preserving German culture and a predominant national culture a primary goal (7.1, 7.2).

reduce-immigration.rationale: Opposition to immigration is a defining trait of the radical right and the AfD wants asylum immigration sharply curbed (9.1, 9.3).

empower-international-orgs.rationale: The AfD rejects transferring sovereignty to the EU and others (1.1, 2.2) and wants national interest at the centre of foreign policy.

free-trade.rationale: The AfD backs lower trade barriers and WTO-based trade (10.3, 10.4), but other radical right parties are protectionist, so strands split.

nation-first.rationale: The AfD says national interest and the welfare of the German people must be at the heart of foreign and security policy (ch. 4).

open-borders.rationale: The AfD calls for border police, border posts and fences (3.9).

limit-growth.rationale: The AfD stresses prosperity and growth and rejects climate policy premises (10.1, 12.1).

drastic-climate-action.rationale: The AfD programme disputes anthropogenic climate models and wants climate policy ended (12.1); other parties are less sceptical.

revolution-justified.rationale: Wikipedia says the radical right works within the electoral system, unlike the extreme right.

experts-over-public.rationale: Populism sets the people against the elite, and the AfD wants public referenda to overrule parliament (1.1).

central-planning.rationale: The AfD says any state-directed economy ends in misallocation and corruption (10.2).

socialized-markets.rationale: The AfD wants private ownership as the basis of the economy (10.2).

tax-inheritance.rationale: The AfD programme calls for abolishing inheritance and wealth taxes (11.4).

basic-income.rationale: The AfD offers only an income-tapered enabling basic income with benefits lower than wages (5.4.2).

tariffs-protect-industry.rationale: Protectionist parties like the National Rally favour tariffs while the AfD wants lower trade barriers; strands split.

state-directs-investment.rationale: The AfD wants subsidies reduced and limited (10.7) and rejects state-directed economy.

abolish-money-wages.rationale: Incompatible with the AfD's market economy based on ownership and free pricing (10.2).

abolish-central-banks.rationale: The AfD attacks the ECB and wants gold repatriated and the monetary system reviewed (11.11) but does not seek abolition.

one-party-rule.rationale: Mudde says populists accept popular sovereignty and majority rule, and the AfD wants limits on party power (1.5).

democracy-best.rationale: Mudde says populists accept the essence of democracy, popular sovereignty and majority rule, though not liberal limits on them.

direct-votes.rationale: The AfD calls Swiss-style referenda non-negotiable (1.1).

workers-councils.rationale: Council rule is incompatible with the AfD's parliamentary and referendum model (ch. 1).

political-violence-never.rationale: Radical right parties accept elections, unlike the extreme right which tolerates violence.

laws-from-scripture.rationale: The AfD calls shari'a incompatible with the legal system and defends a secular constitutional order (7.6).

private-courts-defense.rationale: The AfD names security and justice as core state functions (1.2).

ethnic-nation.rationale: Mudde calls nativism, a state inhabited by the native group, the core of the radical right; Wikipedia describes a homogeneous nation.

class-struggle-history.rationale: The radical right defines politics by nation, not class.

equal-outcomes.rationale: The AfD says equal rights should be equal opportunities (8.3).

limit-population.rationale: The AfD cites population explosion abroad (9.1.1) yet wants more native births (6.2); split.

industrial-civilization-disaster.rationale: The AfD celebrates industry, technology and prosperity (10.6).

unbreakable-encryption.rationale: The AfD says end-to-end encryption must not be prohibited (10.10.2).

results-over-ideology.rationale: Populists present themselves as pragmatic yet are ideologically driven; split.

direct-action.rationale: Parties work through elections even while anti-establishment.

return-to-foraging.rationale: Contradicts the AfD's pro-technology, pro-prosperity stance.

abolish-division-of-labor.rationale: Inconsistent with the market economy the AfD advocates.

distribute-by-need.rationale: Contradicts the AfD's ownership and free-pricing principles (10.2).

production-for-use.rationale: Contradicts profit-based market economy endorsed in 10.2.

profit-exploitation.rationale: The AfD treats ownership and enterprise as the base of prosperity (10.2, 10.9).

dictatorship-of-proletariat.rationale: Incompatible with the AfD's separation of powers (1.3).

collective-farming.rationale: The AfD favours competition and less subsidy in agriculture (13.6).

capitalism-causes-war.rationale: Rejects Marxist premises; the AfD calls trade the foundation of peaceful coexistence (10.4).

taxation-theft.rationale: The AfD wants a tax ceiling but accepts the state's four core functions (1.2, 11.2).

conscription.rationale: The AfD wants conscription for men aged 18 to 25 (4.4.2); other parties are less committed.

exit-over-voice.rationale: The AfD stresses voice through referenda (1.1).

state-as-business.rationale: Nulled (statement review, 2026-11-12): its value turns on whether citizens are customers who can leave, and the statement now asks only whether government should be run on business principles.

reviewHistory.rationale: The AfD wants lean government but says government serves citizens (1.2); not customers who exit.

hereditarian-race.rationale: Radical right parties distinguish themselves from the extreme right, which holds biological racism; strands vary.

total-state.rationale: The AfD wants lean government limited to four classic functions (1.2).

territorial-expansion.rationale: The AfD frames NATO and the army defensively and stresses national interest (4.2).

personal-loyalty-rule.rationale: Inconsistent with the AfD's constitutional state and referendum model.

bound-labor.rationale: Inconsistent with the AfD's market and constitutional order.

universal-morality.rationale: The AfD claims Judeo-Christian and humanist foundations but also stresses culture-specific identity; split.

workplace-democracy.rationale: Incompatible with the AfD's ownership-based market economy (10.2).

avoid-deficit-stimulus.rationale: The AfD wants national debt repaid and a constitutional ceiling on taxes (11.2, 11.9).

economic-freedom.rationale: The AfD programme links free competition with prosperity (10.1).

national-self-determination.rationale: The AfD calls for a Europe of nation states and restoring national powers (2.1, 2.2).

reason-over-faith.rationale: The AfD cites both Christianity and Enlightenment as roots (7.2); split.

welfare-for-citizens.rationale: Welfare chauvinism, benefits for natives only, is a defining radical right position.

work-for-welfare.rationale: The AfD wants benefits lower than wages and work to pay more (5.4.2).

sacrifice-heritage.rationale: The AfD calls preserving cultural heritage a primary goal (7.1).

ban-interest.rationale: Incompatible with the AfD's market economy.

racial-segregation-law.rationale: Radical right parties do not seek race laws, unlike the extreme right.

state-class-instrument.rationale: Marxist premise rejected by the AfD's constitutional framework.

expand-fossil-fuels.rationale: The AfD would scrap the renewable energy act and explore fracking (12.2, 12.5).

assimilate-immigrants.rationale: The AfD calls assimilation the most advanced form of integration and rejects multiculturalism (7.2, 9.4).

elite-replacement.rationale: Mainstream radical right blames elites for immigration but only fringe strands endorse a replacement plot; split.

patriarchy-structural.rationale: The AfD rejects gender ideology and quotas (8.3).

political-elite-corrupt.rationale: Populism, a core element per Mudde, sets a corrupt elite against the pure people; the AfD says the same of the political class (1.6).

heritable-defect-limits.rationale: A eugenic policy belongs to the extreme right, not the parliamentary radical right.

night-watchman-state.rationale: The AfD names four classic functions (1.2), yet welfare-chauvinist strands keep the welfare state; split.

discourage-race-mixing.rationale: Extreme right position; parliamentary radical right does not endorse it.

uniform-civil-code.rationale: The AfD opposes shari'a courts and parallel societies (7.6.1).

restrict-conversion.rationale: The AfD gives unconditional support to freedom of faith and conscience (7.6).

state-strengthens-encirclement.rationale: Marxist-Leninist doctrine contradicts the AfD's lean government (1.2).

consent-of-governed.rationale: Mudde says populists accept popular sovereignty; the AfD wants consent through referenda (1.1).

trade-surplus.rationale: The AfD praises trade but does not set a surplus goal; indifferent.

separated-powers.rationale: The AfD wants to guarantee separation of powers (1.3), though Mudde says radical right erodes liberal checks.

vanguard-party.rationale: Leninist model rejected by the AfD's referendum democracy.

priority-to-poor.rationale: Welfare chauvinism prioritises poor natives, not the poor generally; split.

diversity-weakens-cohesion.rationale: The AfD calls multiculturalism a threat to social peace and the nation as a cultural unit (7.2).

price-controls-essentials.rationale: The AfD calls free pricing a key principle (10.2).

party-controls-media.rationale: The AfD wants a free media policy and opposes compulsory broadcasting fees (7.5).

long-naturalization-wait.rationale: The AfD calls citizenship the final act of integration (9.7).

pool-sovereignty.rationale: The AfD calls for restoring powers of nation states and rejects an EU federal state (2.1, 2.2).

clerical-rule.rationale: The AfD calls shari'a incompatible with the legal order (7.6).

defeat-own-government-war.rationale: Nationalism rules out working for one's own government's defeat.

censor-art-for-virtue.rationale: The AfD wants arts freed from political influence (7.4).

unlimited-reelection.rationale: The AfD wants to limit tenure of career politicians (1.5.4), though Orban-style strands are less strict.

end-foreign-alliances.rationale: The AfD says NATO membership corresponds to German interests as long as it is defensive (4.2).

educated-out-of-touch.rationale: Populists see the educated elite as out of touch with ordinary people.

cultures-equal-different.rationale: The AfD says multiculturalism wrongly puts imported cultures on a par with the indigenous one (7.2).

death-penalty.rationale: Some parties favour it and others oppose it; sources show no common line; split.

sex-ed-in-schools.rationale: The AfD wants early sexualisation and gender mainstreaming ended in schools (8.3).

citizenship-by-descent.rationale: The AfD wants to restore jus sanguinis as valid until 2000 (3.4).

minority-language-support.rationale: The AfD wants German declared the official language (7.3).

religious-exemptions.rationale: The AfD opposes special rights for Muslim pupils (8.2.8).

restrict-freedoms-for-growth.rationale: Mudde says these parties accept popular sovereignty; the AfD defends civil liberties like cash (11.10).

rich-countries-aid-poor.rationale: The AfD limits aid to capacity building in Germany's interest (4.5).

direct-election-head-of-state.rationale: The AfD calls for direct election of the Federal President (1.5.5).

precautionary-principle.rationale: The AfD disputes climate models as the basis for action (12.1).

collective-defense.rationale: The AfD says NATO membership corresponds to German interests (4.2).

subordinate-church-to-state.rationale: The AfD is selective, wanting no public body status for Islamic groups (7.6.4) but protecting Christian heritage; split.

force-to-prevent-secession.rationale: Unionists favour it while the Lega backed autonomy; split.

sacred-ruler.rationale: Incompatible with the AfD's constitutional democracy.

flat-income-tax.rationale: The AfD proposes a bracket tax model (11.1).

sovereign-above-law.rationale: The AfD stresses a constitutional state and separation of powers (1.3).

land-redistribution.rationale: Contradicts the AfD's protection of private ownership (10.2).

apostasy-punishable.rationale: The AfD gives unconditional support to freedom of faith and conscience (7.6).

women-must-cover.rationale: The AfD calls for no full-body veiling in public spaces (7.6.5), the opposite.

common-currency.rationale: The AfD calls for ending the euro and dissolving it in an orderly way (2.4).

material-conditions-drive-history.rationale: Mudde says populism is about values, not money.

ban-cartels.rationale: The AfD calls for antitrust control and competition policy (10.2).

no-bailouts.rationale: The AfD opposes liability for foreign banks and wants bank liability ahead of taxpayers (2.5).

courts-bound-by-majority.rationale: Mudde says radical right parties undermine minority rights and the rule of law, though the AfD claims to respect the constitution.

gender-parity-bodies.rationale: The AfD rejects gender quotas as unfair (8.3.2).

trade-labor-env-standards.rationale: The AfD wants trade agreements to respect German social and environmental standards (10.4).

history-own-civilization.rationale: The AfD wants teaching centred on German culture and tradition (7.1, 7.2).

end-racial-preferences.rationale: The AfD rejects quotas as unfair (8.3.2), by extension racial preferences.

entrenched-bill-of-rights.rationale: The AfD embraces the constitutional state (3.5), but Mudde says radical right undermines liberal checks; split lean agree.

minority-veto.rationale: Mudde says populists accept majority rule.

animal-suffering-matters.rationale: The AfD programme has a section recognising animals as sensitive creatures (13.3).

animal-use-humane.rationale: The AfD treats animals as sensitive creatures and wants humane slaughter rules (13.3, 13.4).

withdraw-from-politics.rationale: Populism calls the people to political action.

return-lost-territory.rationale: Western European radical right do not press this; split.

preserve-contested-monuments.rationale: The AfD wants cultural heritage and tradition preserved (7.1).

paid-care-work.rationale: The AfD wants family care recognised and nursing of relatives rewarded (5.4.3, 5.4.4).

filial-duty.rationale: The AfD wants relative care recognised and supports traditional family (5.4.4, 6.1).

foreign-takeover-block.rationale: The National Rally favours it while the AfD wants foreign and domestic companies treated alike (10.3); split.

individual-pension-accounts.rationale: The AfD seeks reforms but only private schemes for MPs (1.6.1); split.

single-official-language.rationale: The AfD wants German declared the official language in the constitution (7.3).

consumerism-harmful.rationale: The AfD supports consumer protection (10.11) but no stance on consumerism; indifferent.

restrict-foreign-funding.rationale: The AfD wants foreign financing of mosques ended (7.6.3).

pronatalist-incentives.rationale: The AfD calls for larger families instead of mass immigration (6.2).

job-guarantee.rationale: The AfD wants an income-tapered benefit and a freer labour market (5.1, 5.4.2).

no-duty-to-obey.rationale: The AfD stresses law enforcement and the constitutional state (ch. 3).

minority-conspiracy.rationale: Mainstream radical right parties distance themselves from conspiracy claims of the extreme right; split lean disagree.

abolish-legal-marriage.rationale: The AfD says marriage and families enjoy special protection (6.1).

informal-organisation.rationale: Radical right parties are electoral organisations.

national-law-over-international.rationale: The AfD says parliament must keep regulatory sovereignty over trade and EU law (10.3, 1.1).

deference-to-leading-power.rationale: Incompatible with the AfD's sovereignty emphasis (ch. 4).

personal-possessions-private.rationale: Nulled (statement review, 2026-11-12): its value rests on accepting or rejecting common ownership of production, or on private property in general, and the statement now asks only whether personal belongings should stay private where production is held in common.

reviewHistory.rationale: The AfD opposes common ownership of the means of production (10.2).

women-equality-needs-economic-change.rationale: The AfD rejects gender-equality policy as ideology (8.3).

socialized-care.rationale: The AfD wants full-time mothers valued and family care rewarded (6.5, 5.4.4).

cooperative-communities.rationale: Incompatible with the AfD's market economy.

neither-capitalism-nor-communism.rationale: Wikipedia says only extra-parliamentary strands follow Strasserist third-way ideas; parliamentary parties do not.

holocaust-denial.rationale: Wikipedia places such fringe positions with the extreme right, which the radical right separates itself from.

criminalize-homosexuality.rationale: Parliamentary radical right parties do not seek criminalisation, and some are explicitly liberal on this.

suppress-opposition.rationale: Mudde says populists accept democracy, unlike extremists.

punish-blasphemy.rationale: The AfD says religious satire and caricatures are protected opinion (7.6.2).

defensive-jihad-duty.rationale: The AfD treats Islamism as a threat (7.6.1).

unreligious-rulers-fought.rationale: The AfD opposes radicalisation and Islamist order (7.6.1).

intersecting-oppressions.rationale: The AfD calls gender ideology and quotas to be ended (8.3).

gender-identity-recognition.rationale: The AfD says children should not be unsettled about sexual identity and rejects gender ideology (8.3).

alienated-labor.rationale: A Marxist concept foreign to the AfD's ownership-based economy (10.2).

islam-incompatible.rationale: The AfD programme states that Islam does not belong to Germany (7.6.1).

divine-source-of-authority.rationale: Mudde says populists locate virtue in the people, not God.

religious-dress-in-state.rationale: The AfD calls for no full-body veiling in public spaces and no special rights for Muslim pupils (7.6.5, 8.2.8).

social-market-economy.rationale: The AfD calls for the social market economy of Eucken and Erhard (10.2).

abolish-armed-forces.rationale: The AfD wants armed forces restored and conscription (4.4).

stay-neutral-between-blocs.rationale: The AfD says NATO membership corresponds to German interests (4.2).

dynastic-succession.rationale: Incompatible with the AfD's democratic model.

property-franchise.rationale: Mudde says populists accept popular sovereignty and majority rule.

racial-franchise.rationale: Radical right works within democratic citizenship, unlike the extreme right.

interfaith-marriage-restriction.rationale: The AfD gives unconditional support to freedom of faith (7.6).

boycott-minority-shops.rationale: A fringe position of the extreme right.

state-promotes-atheism.rationale: The AfD cites Christianity as a root of German culture (7.2).

abolish-police-prisons.rationale: The AfD wants more police and tougher sentences (3.1, 3.3).

term-limits.rationale: The AfD wants to restrict career politicians by limiting tenure of office (1.5.4).

foreign-residents-local-vote.rationale: The AfD links citizenship to integration and rejects dual citizenship (9.7).

abolish-ip.rationale: Incompatible with the AfD's ownership principle (10.2).

no-foreign-bases.rationale: The AfD says Germany depends on the US (ch. 4) but does not call for bases to leave; split.

never-kill-self-defence.rationale: The AfD backs armed forces and law-abiding gun owners (3.5, 4.4).

no-fixed-category-of-women.rationale: The AfD rejects gender ideology and quotas (8.3).

local-essentials-public.rationale: The AfD requires citizen approval before privatisation (10.8).

anonymous-payments.rationale: The AfD wants unrestricted use of cash (11.10).

online-anonymity.rationale: The AfD defends encryption (10.10.2) but not anonymity; split.

gm-crops.rationale: The AfD cites unknown risks of genetic modification in ecosystems (13.5).

racial-group-interests.rationale: Wikipedia contrasts the radical right with the extreme right, which makes racial claims.

racial-pride.rationale: National pride yes, racial pride is a split among strands.

defensive-wars-only.rationale: The AfD calls NATO a defensive alliance (4.2).

language-defines-nation.rationale: The AfD ties culture to language (7.3) but defines nation by the state; split.

communal-electorates.rationale: Contrary to the AfD's equal citizenship and one predominant culture (7.2).

pollution-taxes.rationale: The AfD rejects climate policy premises (12.1).

arms-reduction.rationale: The AfD wants armed forces strengthened (4.4).

in-work-tax-credits.rationale: The AfD's enabling basic income lets earners keep a substantial part of earnings (5.4.2).

fiscal-rules-binding.rationale: The AfD wants a debt ceiling and constitutional tax ceiling (11.2, 11.9).

public-service-media.rationale: The AfD wants compulsory broadcasting fees abolished (7.5).

religions-one-truth.rationale: The AfD calls Islam incompatible with German values (7.6).

farm-price-support.rationale: The AfD wants less agricultural subsidy and more competition (13.6).

environment-over-liberty.rationale: The AfD opposes climate regulation and stresses civil liberties (12.1, 11.10).

mandatory-sentences.rationale: The AfD wants minimum jail sentences for attacks on officials (3.3).

immigrants-learn-language.rationale: The AfD says successful integration requires a command of German (9.4).

religious-equal-recognition.rationale: The AfD denies public body status to Islamic organisations (7.6.4).

premarital-sex.rationale: Western radical right parties split on traditional sexual morality.

negative-income-tax.rationale: The AfD's enabling basic income tapers benefits as earnings rise (5.4.2).

women-suffrage.rationale: The AfD defends equal rights while rejecting quotas (8.3).

gender-equality-agencies.rationale: The AfD wants gender research and mainstreaming ended (8.1.2, 8.3).

scripture-inerrant.rationale: The AfD cites Enlightenment and scientific heritage (7.2).

indirect-election.rationale: The AfD wants direct election of the president (1.5.5).

national-church-status.rationale: The AfD cites Christianity as a root of culture (7.2) but is silent on church status; split.

equal-conscription.rationale: The AfD wants conscription for men only with voluntary service for women (4.4.2).

extrajudicial-killing.rationale: The AfD stresses constitutional state and fair trials (3.1).

close-ties-china.rationale: Radical right parties split on foreign alignment.

protect-kin-minorities.rationale: The AfD cares for the welfare of German minorities abroad (ch. 4).

targeted-social-spending.rationale: Welfare chauvinists restrict by nationality, not means; split.

no-business-privileges.rationale: The AfD wants lobbyism curbed and subsidies limited (1.6, 10.7).

labour-theory-of-value.rationale: The radical right is nativist and authoritarian, not Marxist, and its economic views run from market liberalism to welfare chauvinism, so it does not hold the labour theory of value.

patriotism-serves-workers.rationale: Welfare chauvinism combines national belonging with state support for native workers, and Mudde's populism sets the pure people against elites, so patriotism and serving ordinary people belong together.

market-under-party-rule.rationale: The radical right is anti-communist and nativist, and no socialist system under a communist party is part of its programme.

police-more-powers.rationale: The AfD programme demands more police staff, minimum sentences for attacks on officers, a restored armed forces and conscription (3.1, 3.3, 4.4). (Moved from empower-police-military, 2026-11-11, when that statement became about military spending alone.)

decent-living-guarantee.rationale: Welfare chauvinism favours cutting benefits for outsiders, not welfare as such, and the AfD wants work incentives rather than cuts (5.4.2); strands split. (Carried over from cut-welfare, "Welfare programs create dependency and should be cut.", with the value reversed, 2026-11-11.)

missingStatements.text: Foreign nationals convicted of serious crimes should be deported.
missingStatements.rationale: The AfD programme calls for lowering hurdles to forced repatriation and combining criminal convictions with repatriation orders.
missingStatements.declined: Narrow single-issue immigration rule; reduce-immigration and assimilate-immigrants already place the ideology.

missingStatements.text: Citizens should not be allowed to hold dual nationality.
missingStatements.rationale: The AfD rejects dual citizenship in principle and links citizenship to language and culture.
missingStatements.declined: Narrow single-issue citizenship rule; long-naturalization-wait and citizenship-by-descent already place the ideology.

missingStatements.text: No significant international treaty or transfer of national powers should take effect without a direct popular vote.
missingStatements.rationale: The AfD says the constitution may not change and no significant treaty be entered without direct approval of the people, especially transfers of sovereignty to the EU.

notes: Strands differ: the AfD is market-liberal and climate-sceptic, the National Rally more protectionist and statist, and the PVV most focused on Islam. Mudde stresses that not all of these parties share every position, so many economic answers are low-confidence.
